purpose: Minimal, auditable contract between Benji's controller and Bob's keeper for the single-sided LP buyback on Uniswap V3 (Base). One position, three actions. Active laddering is a deferred separate module — NOT here, to keep v1 small.
venue: Uniswap V3 on Base — canonical NonfungiblePositionManager (no fork). Pool = (token0, token1, fee); fee ∈ {100,500,3000,10000} (tick spacing derives from fee).
amounts: All token/USDC quantities are DECIMAL STRINGS in human units (e.g. "5000", "1000000") — 18-dec supplies are not float-safe. Prices (P_top/P_bot/spot) are numbers for display; ticks are authoritative for on-chain math.

intent.id: string · idempotency key — keeper dedupes; retries never double-execute
intent.P_top: number · upper bound = current spot, USDC/token (mint only)
intent.usdc: decimal string · USDC to deposit (mint only)

fill_report.mode: "LIVE" | "SIMULATED" · controller books LIVE only; SIMULATED is a dry-run for wiring/tests

conventions: Single-sided mint: deposit USDC only, range entirely below spot (P_top = spot). At the bottom it's 100% token = buyback done.
in/out are wallet-perspective: usdc_in spent, token_out received. PnL reconstructed purely from fill_reports with integer/decimal math.
Controller trusts realized_P_bot/P_top from the keeper (decimals + token0/1 ordering resolved on-chain) — does not recompute price from raw ticks.
Controller holds NO keys — keeper owns a dedicated isolated signer. Standard ERC-20 approve before mint (keeper-internal).
No rerange / roll / emissions in v1. If active laddering is added later, it reuses these same three actions in a loop; this contract does not change.
